Sources: [Liu et al., PMID 31792460](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31792460/); [cBioPortal mel_dfci_2019](https://github.com/cBioPortal/datahub/tree/e1b75cd25bf7436d16719b7d76117ad8f3f66e54/public/mel_dfci_2019); [Riaz et al., PMID 29033130](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29033130/); [GEO GSE91061](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE91061). Primary-publication recruitment evidence: Liu et al. state that tissue was collected locally at participating sites from January 2013 through June 2016. The primary paper names additional sample contributors at University Hospital Münster, University Hospital Essen, Laikon General Hospital, NCT Dresden, The Netherlands Cancer Institute, University Hospital Zürich and Technical University Munich; it does not label this as an exhaustive recruitment roster. [Liu et al., primary paper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/6898788/). Riaz et al. report 85 patients accrued to multi-arm, multi-institutional CA209-038 (CheckMate 038; NCT01621490). The primary paper key-resources table lists tumor-biopsy sources at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (New York), Providence Cancer Center (Portland), Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (Boston), Instituto de Investigación Sanitaria de Navarra (Pamplona), Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center at Johns Hopkins (Baltimore), University of Washington (Seattle), MD Anderson Cancer Center (Houston), University of Chicago, and University of Virginia School of Medicine (Charlottesville). Calendar accrual dates are not reported in the article. [Riaz et al., primary paper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5685550/).
